blocks.placement_intent: USB entry and eFuse sit at the source; protected 5 V leaves to the right toward sense and conversion
Shunt sits in the 5 V trunk; INA226 Kelvin-senses beside it
TPS62913 input capacitors at the 5 V arrival, inductor and 3V3 bulk toward the loads
LED eFuse after 5V_SYS; left and right LED rails leave toward the west-edge connectors
Microphone LDO and NFC 5 V filter hang off 5V_SYS toward their domains
Reset supervisor and boot straps at the POR_B side; RT1062 body central in the compute cluster
Local decoupling stays beside the RT1062 rail pins it serves, not in a remote bank
24 MHz crystal beside the oscillator pins; QSPI flash on the FlexSPI escape
SWD header and BootROM UART sit on the RT1062 side, never through ESP32_S3
WROOM module with EN/BOOT support at the radio cluster; antenna clearance implied to the east
Service USB connector and ESD at the ESP32_S3 USB PHY pins
SPI series resistors sit on the seam between RT1062 master and ESP32_S3 slave
TLV320ADC6120 central; supply decoupling local; TDM toward RT1062 SAI
Series and isolation options on AUDIO_MCLK/BCLK/FSYNC so a laboratory clock can take over
Flex microphone connector and 0R XOR so the two PDM routes cannot load the bus together
ST25R3916B, 27.12 MHz crystal and matching stay on the carrier; antenna terminals at the RF edge
Accelerometer near structural centre; 0R XOR matrix drawn beside the I2C and IRQ lines
Level shifters between RT1062 3.3 V data and the 5 V strip connectors J2/J3
Option links as fitted or DNP resistors on named validation straps
POR_B wired-OR parts and the ESP32_S3-independent Serial Downloader path beside debug
